headline: Sensex and Nifty end marginally lower during Diwali Muhurat trading session, snapping seven-day rally

marketStatus.message: Today is Diwali Laxmi Pujan. NSE will conduct Muhurat Trading. Exact trading timings are notified separately by NSE.

why: Sensex and Nifty ended marginally lower during the Diwali Muhurat trading session, breaking a seven-day winning streak.
Bharti Airtel and Infosys emerged as top losers during the Muhurat session, weighing down the indices.
Indian markets halted an eight-year streak of positive Diwali session returns.
Earlier in the week, Indian equities posted their best weekly performance in six years, bucking global tech market declines.
whatHappening: BSE and NSE conducted the annual Muhurat trading session on Diwali Laxmi Pujan.
Nifty ended the special session below the 25,000 mark following profit-taking at higher levels.
Kalpataru CFO expressed confidence in achieving the Rs 6,500-crore FY27 pre-sales target due to robust home demand.
Investors are now preparing for Monday's regular trading session as market participants monitor upcoming triggers.
summary: Indian stock markets held the special Muhurat trading session on Diwali Laxmi Pujan, with Sensex and Nifty ending marginally lower to snap a seven-day rally. Bharti Airtel and Infosys were among the top losers as Nifty settled below 25,000. Investors now turn their attention to key triggers driving the market action on Monday.
